topic: Earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and surface changes
key_concepts: Movement of Earth's crust causes earthquakes
Earthquakes can collapse structures and crack roads
Earthquakes can trigger landslides and tsunamis
Earthquakes can cause liquefaction of loosely packed sediments
Magma pushes up rocks from underneath; lava flows out of vents and crater
Volcanic eruptions occur when pressure increases inside a volcano
Pyroclastic materials like ashes and rocks spread around a volcano
Lahars carry materials from ash to boulders into rivers and lakes during heavy rain
Volcanic eruptions can build up land and form fertile soil
Volcanic eruptions can cover houses, properties, and vegetation and change landscapes
Volcanic eruptions can crack or break buildings, bridges, and roads
